fact: On 14 September 2026 the Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité in Bamako sentenced journalist Abdrahamane Keïta to three years (two to serve) for false information through an information system and an offence undermining national unity, after his summons on 9 June 2026.
title: Journalist sentenced to two years in prison for commenting on security situation during TV programme
